description: This file implements the IdentityCredential class, which manages identity credentials including creation, deletion, proof of ownership, key pair generation, and retrieval of credential data. It interacts with secure hardware proxies and handles CBOR encoding/decoding, cryptographic operations, and access control validation within the Android hardware identity framework.

classes.name: IdentityCredential
classes.description: Represents an identity credential that manages credential data, cryptographic operations, and interactions with secure hardware for identity verification and data retrieval.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the credential by parsing credential data CBOR, extracting document type, test credential flag, and encrypted keys, then initializes the hardware proxy.

methods.name: deleteCredential
methods.description: Deletes the credential and returns a proof of deletion signature.

methods.name: deleteCredentialWithChallenge
methods.description: Deletes the credential with a challenge and returns a proof of deletion signature.

methods.name: deleteCredentialCommon
methods.description: Common internal method to handle credential deletion logic, including signing proof of deletion.

methods.name: proveOwnership
methods.description: Generates a proof of ownership signature based on a challenge.

methods.name: createEphemeralKeyPair
methods.description: Creates an ephemeral key pair for secure communication.

methods.name: setReaderEphemeralPublicKey
methods.description: Sets the reader's ephemeral public key.

methods.name: setRequestedNamespaces
methods.description: Sets the requested namespaces for data retrieval.

methods.name: startRetrieval
methods.description: Begins the credential data retrieval process, handling session transcript, access control, and certificate validation.

methods.name: startRetrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Prepares to retrieve a specific entry's value, enforcing access control and namespace constraints.

methods.name: retrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts a chunk of entry data, accumulating until complete.

methods.name: finishRetrieval
methods.description: Completes the retrieval process, producing a CBOR-encoded device namespace map and optional MAC.

methods.name: generateSigningKeyPair
methods.description: Generates a signing key pair and returns the key blob and certificate.

methods.name: updateCredential
methods.description: Prepares an writable credential object for updating the credential data.
